Based on the timeline provided in the conversations, it appears that the process did not take more than three weeks. Initially, LiHua inquired about adding an air-conditioner to the basement on July 16th at 10:00 AM (Source 1). Adam Smith confirmed the possibility and suggested checking with the maintenance team (Source 1). He then reached out to the maintenance team and mentioned he would reach out right away (Source 2). 

The actual installation of the air-conditioner occurred on August 12th at 6:00 PM (Source 3), which indicates a timeframe of less than three weeks from the initial request to the completion of the installation. Therefore, the process did not exceed the three-week mark.
